strings.adc_saturated: ADC saturated at %.2f%% of full scale. Check the bridge excitation and the gain.
strings.analog_power_failed: Powering up the analog section failed
strings.avdd_ldo: AVDD from the internal LDO at %.1f V
strings.avdd_pin: AVDD from the pin; if the cell reads nothing this board may need 'i2c-nau7802 init ldo 3.0'
strings.calibrate.help: Derive the scale from a known mass
strings.calibrate_how: Run 'i2c-nau7802 tare' with the scale empty first, then place a known mass and run this. The unit is whatever you use here.
strings.calibrate_more_samples: For about %.2f%%, run 'i2c-nau7802 tare 100' and 'i2c-nau7802 calibrate %g 100'
strings.calibrate_precision: Scale good to +/-%.2f%% (%.1f counts of uncertainty)
strings.calibrated: Calibrated: %.1f counts per unit (%.1f counts for %.4f units)
strings.calibration_cal_err: Internal calibration failed (CTRL2.CAL_ERR). Check the bridge wiring and the reference voltage.
strings.digital_power_failed: Powering up the digital section failed
strings.drdy.help: Show or set the GPIO wired to the DRDY output
strings.drdy_absent: No DRDY pin; polling the CR bit over I2C. Wire DRDY and use 'i2c-nau7802 init drdy <pin>' if readings show outliers.
strings.drdy_config_failed: Configuring GPIO %d as the DRDY input failed
strings.drdy_configured: Conversions signalled by DRDY on GPIO %d
strings.drdy_confirm: Run 'i2c-nau7802 read' to confirm; a wrong pin times out
strings.drdy_not_a_number: DRDY must be a GPIO number
strings.drdy_polling: No DRDY pin; conversions are detected by polling the CR status bit over I2C
strings.drdy_released: DRDY released; back to polling the CR status bit over I2C
strings.drdy_state_high: DRDY on GPIO %d, high (a result is waiting) right now
strings.drdy_state_low: DRDY on GPIO %d, low (no result waiting) right now
strings.drdy_timeout: DRDY (GPIO %d) never went high. Check the wiring, or run 'i2c-nau7802 drdy off' to poll over I2C instead.
strings.gain.help: Show or set the PGA gain
strings.gain_headroom: The PGA is at gain x%d: 'i2c-nau7802 gain 128' would make the signal %dx larger, which averaging cannot.
strings.gain_reset_default: That is the reset default, not a choice: 'i2c-nau7802 init' returns the gain to x1, and a load cell needs 'i2c-nau7802 gain 128'.
strings.gain_set: Gain set to x%d; re-running internal offset calibration
strings.gpio_absent: GPIO %d does not exist on this chip
strings.group.help: Nuvoton NAU7802 24-bit bridge ADC / load cell at 0x2a
strings.init_drdy_missing: Give the GPIO the DRDY pin is wired to, e.g. 'i2c-nau7802 init drdy 7'
strings.init_gain_missing: Give the gain, e.g. 'i2c-nau7802 init gain 128'
strings.init_ldo_missing: Give the LDO voltage, e.g. 'i2c-nau7802 init ldo 3.0'
strings.init_scale_missing: Give the scale factor, e.g. 'i2c-nau7802 init scale 214.7'
strings.input.help: Show or set the input channel
strings.input_channel_set: Input channel set to %s; re-running internal offset calibration
strings.ldo_choices: LDO voltage must be one of:
strings.ldo_not_a_number: LDO voltage must be a number
strings.ldomode.help: Show or set the regulator loop compensation (AVDD cap ESR)
strings.ldomode_help_0: 0  AVDD capacitor ESR below 1 ohm (chip default)
strings.ldomode_help_1: 1  AVDD capacitor ESR up to 5 ohms
strings.ldomode_is_strict: LDOMODE 0: the AVDD capacitor must have ESR below 1 ohm
strings.ldomode_is_tolerant: LDOMODE 1: the AVDD capacitor may have ESR up to 5 ohms
strings.ldomode_set: LDOMODE set to %d; re-running internal offset calibration
strings.mass_invalid: The known mass must be a non-zero number
strings.need_two_samples: 'i2c-nau7802 tare' and 'i2c-nau7802 calibrate' need at least two samples. Re-run as 'i2c-nau7802 tare 10' and 'i2c-nau7802 calibrate %g 10'.
strings.no_scale: No scale factor. Run 'i2c-nau7802 tare' then 'i2c-nau7802 calibrate <known mass>', or set one with 'i2c-nau7802 scale <counts_per_unit>'.
strings.no_tare: No tare yet; run 'i2c-nau7802 tare' with the cell empty before weighing
strings.not_calibrated: Not calibrated. Run 'i2c-nau7802 tare' with no load, then 'i2c-nau7802 calibrate <known mass>'.

not_initialized.text: NAU7802 not initialized. Run 'i2c-nau7802 init' first.

strings.not_this_session: Not initialized by this session; run 'i2c-nau7802 init'
strings.offset_cal_ok: Offset calibration passed. Run 'i2c-nau7802 tare' with no load, then 'i2c-nau7802 calibrate <known mass>'.
strings.offset_cal_ok_scale: Offset calibration passed. Scale %.1f counts per unit (supplied); run 'i2c-nau7802 tare' with no load, then 'i2c-nau7802 weight'.
strings.pgacap.help: Show or set the PGA output bypass capacitor
strings.pgacap_disabled: PGA output bypass capacitor disabled; channel B is an input again
strings.pgacap_enabled: PGA output bypass capacitor enabled; it does nothing unless one is fitted across VIN2P/VIN2N. Channel B now reads the filter node, not an input.
strings.power_read_failed: Reading the power control register failed
strings.rate.help: Show or set the sample rate in SPS
strings.rate_320_warning: Note: 320 SPS has been seen returning full-range garbage on the internal RC oscillator
strings.rate_choices: Sample rate must be one of: 10 20 40 80 320 SPS
strings.rate_not_a_number: Sample rate must be a number
strings.rate_set: Sample rate set to %d SPS; re-running internal offset calibration
strings.rate_undefined: Sample rate register holds an undefined encoding
strings.read.help: Averaged raw ADC counts, in units if calibrated
strings.read_raw: Raw %10.1f counts  (%d samples, spread %ld, %.4f%% of full scale)
strings.reg15_mismatch: REG0x15 reads 0x%02X, not 0x30 -- the write did not take
strings.scale.help: Show or set the scale factor without measuring one
strings.scale_is_measured: Scale %.1f counts per unit (measured this session)
strings.scale_is_supplied: Scale %.1f counts per unit (supplied, not measured this session)
strings.scale_not_a_number: Scale factor must be a number
strings.scale_set: Scale set to %.1f counts per unit (supplied, not measured)
strings.scale_supplied_note: This factor belongs to the gain now in force, and any change to the analog path drops it. To survive bring-up, give it as 'i2c-nau7802 init ... scale %.17g'.
strings.scale_zero: Scale factor must not be zero
strings.set_pgacap_failed: Setting the PGA output bypass capacitor: %s
strings.status_drdy: Data ready: DRDY on GPIO %d, now %s
strings.status_drdy_polling: Data ready: no DRDY pin, polling the CR bit over I2C
strings.status_pga: PGA     0x%02X  LDOMODE %d (AVDD capacitor ESR up to %s)
strings.tare.help: Capture the zero offset with no load
strings.tare_drift: Moved %.1f counts from the tare, within the +/-%.1f the two averages are known to. Is the mass on the cell, and was 'i2c-nau7802 tare' run empty? Or average harder: 'i2c-nau7802 tare 100' then 'i2c-nau7802 calibrate %g 100'.
strings.tare_missing: A scale factor is set but no tare has been taken, so every weight would be the bridge's own offset reported as load. Run 'i2c-nau7802 tare' with the cell empty.
strings.tare_scale_dropped: Tare and scale dropped; run 'i2c-nau7802 tare' and 'i2c-nau7802 calibrate' again.
strings.tare_scale_dropped_supplied: Tare and scale dropped: a supplied factor belongs to the gain it was measured at. Give both with 'i2c-nau7802 init ... gain <n> scale <counts_per_unit>'.
strings.tare_set: Tare set to %ld counts (%d samples, spread %ld, mean known to +/-%.1f)
strings.weight: Weight %12.4f units  (+/-%.4f over %d samples, spread %.4f, %.1f raw counts)
strings.weight.help: Report the load in calibrated units
strings.weight_one_sample: Weight %12.4f units  (1 sample, no noise estimate, %.1f raw counts)
strings.weight_precision_note: The +/- on a weight is repeatability, not the accuracy of a supplied factor
